sourceBodies.source:
local spawn = script.Parent
spawn.Touched:connect(function(hit)
	if hit and hit.Parent and hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
		local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
		local checkpointData = game.ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("CheckpointData")
		if not checkpointData then
			checkpointData = Instance.new("Model", game.ServerStorage)
			checkpointData.Name = "CheckpointData"
		end
		
		local checkpoint = checkpointData:FindFirstChild(tostring(player.userId))
		if not checkpoint then
			checkpoint = Instance.new("ObjectValue", checkpointData)
			checkpoint.Name = tostring(player.userId)
			
			player.CharacterAdded:connect(function(character)
				wait()
				character:WaitForChild("Torso").CFrame = game.ServerStorage.CheckpointData[tostring(player.userId)].Value.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
			end)
		end
		
		checkpoint.Value = spawn
	end
end)

plan.reason: Adapt legacy checkpoint script into an ordered progression checkpoint pad compatible with R6/R15 characters, sequential order validation (1 -> 2 -> 3), visual activation feedback, and fall recovery checkpoint tracking.

replaceSources.source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local pad = script.Parent
local order = pad:GetAttribute("CheckpointOrder") or 1

local light = pad:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("PointLight")
if not light then
	light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255)
	light.Range = 12
	light.Brightness = 0
	light.Parent = pad
end

local function activateVisuals()
	pad.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	pad.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255)
	
	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local tween = TweenService:Create(light, tweenInfo, { Brightness = 2.5, Range = 16 })
	tween:Play()
end

local function onTouched(hit)
	if not hit or not hit.Parent then return end
	local character = hit.Parent
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
	
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if not player then return end
	
	local currentCP = player:GetAttribute("CurrentCheckpoint") or 0
	if currentCP == order - 1 then
		player:SetAttribute("CurrentCheckpoint", order)
		player:SetAttribute("LastCheckpointPosition", pad.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0))
		activateVisuals()
		
		local sound = pad:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Sound")
		if sound then
			sound:Play()
		end
	end
end

pad.Touched:Connect(onTouched)

preservedBehavior: Retains checkpoint pad part geometry, dimensions, and surface decal texture.
Retains touch detection when player character steps onto the pad platform.
remainingIntegration: Marketplace audio asset for checkpoint activation chime must be acquired and attached as a Sound child of the Checkpoint pad.
Central course manager must duplicate and configure three instances of the pad with CheckpointOrder attributes 1, 2, and 3 along the course path.
Fall hazard plane and HUD timer controllers need integration with player attributes CurrentCheckpoint and LastCheckpointPosition.
nativeTestPlan: Step onto Checkpoint 2 or 3 before Checkpoint 1 and verify that no activation light triggers and CurrentCheckpoint attribute remains 0.
Step onto Checkpoint 1 and verify that the pad material turns to Neon, PointLight activates, and CurrentCheckpoint updates to 1.
Step onto Checkpoint 2 and verify successful activation to 2, then step onto Checkpoint 3 and verify progression to 3.
Trigger fall hazard after reaching Checkpoint 2 and verify player respawns/teleports to Checkpoint 2 position without losing progress.
